Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the source and incorrectly identified the aircraft as the YB-17 prototype. Major Ployer “Pete” Hill died test-flying Boeing Model 299, civil registration NX13372—the prototype of what became the B-17 Flying Fortress—not a YB-17. This conflation of the Model 299 prototype with the later YB-17 service-test variant led to the wrong airplane being reported.
